- [Configurations](https://docs.ideal-postcodes.co.uk/docs/category/api/configurations.md)

- [Changelog](https://docs.ideal-postcodes.co.uk/docs/changelog.md): Stay informed about the latest updates and improvements to our address validation services with our changelog. View release notes and see what's new.
- [Ideal Postcodes CLI](https://docs.ideal-postcodes.co.uk/docs/cli.md): idpc is the official command line interface for Ideal Postcodes. It manages API keys, cleanses messy addresses, validates emails and phone numbers, and resolves specific addresses from partial queries.
- [idpc auth](https://docs.ideal-postcodes.co.uk/docs/cli/auth.md): Manage stored credentials at ~/.config/ideal-postcodes/credentials.json (or %APPDATA%\ideal-postcodes\credentials.json on Windows, or $XDGCONFIGHOME/ideal-postcodes/... if set). The file is written with mode 0600.
- [idpc cleanse](https://docs.ideal-postcodes.co.uk/docs/cli/cleanse.md): Clean messy address strings — POST /cleanse/addresses. Requires api_key. Each input counts as a paid lookup.
- [idpc email](https://docs.ideal-postcodes.co.uk/docs/cli/email.md): Validate email addresses — GET /emails. Requires api_key. Each input counts as a paid lookup.
- [idpc find & resolve](https://docs.ideal-postcodes.co.uk/docs/cli/find.md): Address autocomplete — two-step by design. Useful when you need to pin a specific address from partial info before using it downstream.
- [idpc keys](https://docs.ideal-postcodes.co.uk/docs/cli/keys.md): Inspect and manage API keys.
- [idpc phone](https://docs.ideal-postcodes.co.uk/docs/cli/phone.md): Validate phone numbers — GET /phonenumbers. Requires apikey. Each input counts as a paid lookup.
- [Glossary](https://docs.ideal-postcodes.co.uk/docs/glossary.md): ---

### Address Finder

Add Address Validation to your address forms in moments with our Address Finder JavaScript package. Simple and quick set up. Guides and live technical support available.

- [Address Finder](https://docs.ideal-postcodes.co.uk/docs/address-finder.md): Add Address Validation to your address forms in moments with our Address Finder JavaScript package. Simple and quick set up. Guides and live technical support available.
- [Retrieve Additional Data](https://docs.ideal-postcodes.co.uk/docs/address-finder/additional-data.md): You can retrieve more data for an address by passing more arguments into outputFields.
- [Bias By Geolocation](https://docs.ideal-postcodes.co.uk/docs/address-finder/bias-by-geolocation.md): Bias search to a geospatial circle determined by an origin and radius in metres. Max radius is 50000.
- [Bias By IP](https://docs.ideal-postcodes.co.uk/docs/address-finder/bias-by-ip.md): Biases search based on approximate geolocation of an IP address. Set bias_ip to true within queryOptions to enable.
- [Bias By Postcode](https://docs.ideal-postcodes.co.uk/docs/address-finder/bias-by-postcode.md): Display address results that closely match the chosen postcode value.
- [Callbacks](https://docs.ideal-postcodes.co.uk/docs/address-finder/callbacks.md): Address Finder also provides callbacks which let you hook into the following events:
- [Configuration Reference](https://docs.ideal-postcodes.co.uk/docs/address-finder/configuration-reference.md): A complete reference for every option accepted by AddressFinder.setup. Only apiKey and outputFields are required; everything else is optional and has a sensible default.
- [Configure](https://docs.ideal-postcodes.co.uk/docs/address-finder/configure.md): Address Finder exports a setup method to apply address verification to a form. setup requires the following configuration at minimum.
- [Convert ISO-3 to ISO-2](https://docs.ideal-postcodes.co.uk/docs/address-finder/convert-iso-code.md): By default, the Ideal Postcodes API returns country code in ISO-3 format.
- [CSS Classes](https://docs.ideal-postcodes.co.uk/docs/address-finder/css-classes.md): The Address Finder can be styled with CSS classes.
- [Setting the default country](https://docs.ideal-postcodes.co.uk/docs/address-finder/default-country.md): detectCountry disables the country detection on Address Finder and defaultCountry sets the default country.
- [Default Styling](https://docs.ideal-postcodes.co.uk/docs/address-finder/default-styling.md): Address Finder's default styling works by injecting a style tag into the document head.
- [Detach and Re-attach Address Finder on your form](https://docs.ideal-postcodes.co.uk/docs/address-finder/detach-reattach-af.md): Detaching Address Finder
- [Filter By Country](https://docs.ideal-postcodes.co.uk/docs/address-finder/filter-by-country.md): Display address results that match the chosen country (England, Wales, Scotland, Northern Ireland, Jersey, Guernsey and Isle of Man) using queryOptions.
- [Filter By Geospatial Box](https://docs.ideal-postcodes.co.uk/docs/address-finder/filter-by-geospatial-box.md): Restrict search to a geospatial box determined by the "top-left" and "bottom-right" geolocations.
- [Filter By Locality](https://docs.ideal-postcodes.co.uk/docs/address-finder/filter-by-locality.md): Display address results that match the chosen locality, like a post town (post_town) using queryOptions.
- [Filter By Postcode Outward](https://docs.ideal-postcodes.co.uk/docs/address-finder/filter-by-postcode-outward.md): Display address results that match the chosen postcode outward value.
- [Hide Address Fields](https://docs.ideal-postcodes.co.uk/docs/address-finder/hide.md): Hide
- [Hide the country toolbar](https://docs.ideal-postcodes.co.uk/docs/address-finder/hide-toolbar.md): Suppress the toolbar that renders below the suggestion list on focus.
- [How it Works](https://docs.ideal-postcodes.co.uk/docs/address-finder/how-it-works.md): Address Finder can be attached to any form with pre-existing address inputs.
- [Checking the usability of your key](https://docs.ideal-postcodes.co.uk/docs/address-finder/key-usability.md): Your key may not be available at some times. For instance:
- [Messages](https://docs.ideal-postcodes.co.uk/docs/address-finder/messages.md): Address Finder uses a small default set of messages to communicate specific events to the user. All of Address Finder's default messages can be overridden. They are outlined below:
- [Attach Multiple Instances](https://docs.ideal-postcodes.co.uk/docs/address-finder/multiple.md): Address Finder can be invoked multiple times to attach multiple instances to your forms.
- [Package Manager (npm)](https://docs.ideal-postcodes.co.uk/docs/address-finder/npm.md): Address Finder is also available without transpilation or minification on npm as @ideal-postcodes/address-finder.
- [Vertically Shift Address Finder](https://docs.ideal-postcodes.co.uk/docs/address-finder/nudge-address-finder.md): From time to time, you may want to tweak the default style of Address Finder to better match your application's design system.
- [Omit Organisation Name](https://docs.ideal-postcodes.co.uk/docs/address-finder/omit-organisation.md): In many countries including the UK, the organisation name will take precedence as the first line of an address if it is present.
- [Populate a country select](https://docs.ideal-postcodes.co.uk/docs/address-finder/populate-country-select.md): Your form may capture country with a ` rather than a free text  - for example a checkout that stores the ISO-3 country code ("GBR", "IRL", "FRA"`) against the order.
- [Prevent Autofill](https://docs.ideal-postcodes.co.uk/docs/address-finder/prevent-autofill.md): Sets the autocomplete= attribute of the input element. Setting this attribute aims to prevent some browsers (particularly Chrome) from providing a clashing autofill overlay.
- [Add to your React Application](https://docs.ideal-postcodes.co.uk/docs/address-finder/react.md): @ideal-postcodes/react is the official integration for Address Finder. It renders an `, attaches the widget, and hands selected addresses back through callbacks — no useEffect or useRef` wiring required.
- [Restrict search to chosen countries](https://docs.ideal-postcodes.co.uk/docs/address-finder/restrict-country.md): Narrow the countries you wish to support.
- [Drop-In Script](https://docs.ideal-postcodes.co.uk/docs/address-finder/script.md): Address Finder is shipped in a polyfilled, typed and minified package called address-finder-bundled.
- [Separate Input from Address](https://docs.ideal-postcodes.co.uk/docs/address-finder/separate-input.md): Specify an inputField to apply the Address Finder to a field other than the first line of the address.
- [Display Address in One Line](https://docs.ideal-postcodes.co.uk/docs/address-finder/single-field.md): Instead of writing each address attribute to individual fields, you may exercise fine control over how address data is presented using the onAddressRetrieved callback.
- [Style with JavaScript](https://docs.ideal-postcodes.co.uk/docs/address-finder/style-js.md): It's possible that the default styling may require a small tweak to allow it to better match your design and site aesthetic. Rather than adding CSS assets, we recommend applying a style attribute as a setup configuration option. The configurations below apply a style attribute directly to a specific element of the address finder.
- [Tag Resolve Requests](https://docs.ideal-postcodes.co.uk/docs/address-finder/tag-resolve.md): Tag your address resolve requests with metadata for usage tracking. Tags are appended to the resolve API call (the second request that retrieves the full address when a suggestion is selected).

### API Reference

A REST service over HTTPS, returning JSON and authenticated with an API key. Endpoints are grouped below by use case.

- [API Reference](https://docs.ideal-postcodes.co.uk/docs/api.md): A REST service over HTTPS, returning JSON and authenticated with an API key. Endpoints are grouped below by use case.
- [Cleanse Address](https://docs.ideal-postcodes.co.uk/docs/api/address-cleanse.md): The address cleanse API attempts to return the closest matching address for any given address inputs. We also return a number of Match Level indicators that describe the degree to which the suggested address matches the input address. The more impaired the input address, the harder it is to cleanse.
- [Address Search](https://docs.ideal-postcodes.co.uk/docs/api/address-search.md): A two-step typeahead flow. Find returns ranked candidates from a partial query; Resolve fetches the full structured address for the chosen candidate. Use bias and filter parameters (country, postcode, geolocation) to keep results local to your audience.
- [Verify Address](https://docs.ideal-postcodes.co.uk/docs/api/address-verify.md): The address verify API validates, corrects, and standardizes individual addresses based on USPS's Coding Accuracy Support System (CASS).
- [Extract Addresses](https://docs.ideal-postcodes.co.uk/docs/api/addresses.md): Extract a list of complete addresses that match the query ordered by relevance score. This query accepts an optional limit and page query (defaults to 10 and 0 respectively).
- [API Reference](https://docs.ideal-postcodes.co.uk/docs/api/api-reference.md): ## Getting Started
- [Create](https://docs.ideal-postcodes.co.uk/docs/api/create-config.md): Create a configuration
- [Create](https://docs.ideal-postcodes.co.uk/docs/api/create-licensee.md): Create a licensee for the specified API Key.
- [Delete](https://docs.ideal-postcodes.co.uk/docs/api/delete-config.md): Permanently deletes a configuration object.
- [Cancel](https://docs.ideal-postcodes.co.uk/docs/api/delete-licensee.md): Cancels a licensee key. This renders a licensee unusable. This action can be reversed if you get in contact with us.
- [Email Validation](https://docs.ideal-postcodes.co.uk/docs/api/email-validation.md): Query for and validate email addresses.
- [Find Address](https://docs.ideal-postcodes.co.uk/docs/api/find-address.md): The Address Autocomplete API delivers address suggestions in order of relevance based on a provided query. It aids real-time address autofill implementations.
- [Find Place](https://docs.ideal-postcodes.co.uk/docs/api/find-place.md): Query for geographical places across countries. Each query will return a list of place suggestions, which consists of a place name, descriptive name and id.
- [Availability](https://docs.ideal-postcodes.co.uk/docs/api/key-availability.md): Returns public information on your API Key.
- [Details](https://docs.ideal-postcodes.co.uk/docs/api/key-details.md): Returns private data on the key including remaining lookups, available datasets and usage limits.
- [Logs (CSV)](https://docs.ideal-postcodes.co.uk/docs/api/key-logs.md): Reports lookup information on a key for paid lookups.
- [Usage Stats](https://docs.ideal-postcodes.co.uk/docs/api/key-usage.md): Reports the number of lookups consumed on a key for a range of days.
- [Keys](https://docs.ideal-postcodes.co.uk/docs/api/keys.md): Inspect and manage your API keys programmatically — check balance, update settings, audit usage, and export logs. Useful for embedding key health into dashboards or pre-flighting requests from the browser.
- [List](https://docs.ideal-postcodes.co.uk/docs/api/list-configs.md): Lists configurations associated with a key
- [List](https://docs.ideal-postcodes.co.uk/docs/api/list-licensees.md): Returns a list of licensees for a key.
- [Phone Number Validation](https://docs.ideal-postcodes.co.uk/docs/api/phone-number-validation.md): Query for and validate phone numbers.
- [Lookup Postcode](https://docs.ideal-postcodes.co.uk/docs/api/postcodes.md): Returns the complete list of addresses for a postcode. Postcode searches are space and case insensitive.
- [Resolve Address](https://docs.ideal-postcodes.co.uk/docs/api/resolve-address.md): Resolves an address autocompletion by its address ID.
- [Resolve Place](https://docs.ideal-postcodes.co.uk/docs/api/resolve-place.md): Resolves a place autocompletion by its place ID.
- [Retrieve Address](https://docs.ideal-postcodes.co.uk/docs/api/retrieve-address.md): Resolves an address autocompletion by its address ID.
- [Retrieve](https://docs.ideal-postcodes.co.uk/docs/api/retrieve-config.md): Retrieve configuration object by name
- [Retrieve](https://docs.ideal-postcodes.co.uk/docs/api/retrieve-licensee.md): Returns licensee information as identified by the licensee key.
- [Retrieve by UDPRN](https://docs.ideal-postcodes.co.uk/docs/api/udprn.md): Returns an address as identified by its Unique Delivery Point Reference Number (UDPRN).
- [UK](https://docs.ideal-postcodes.co.uk/docs/api/uk.md): Endpoints tailored to UK address data. Look up all addresses at a postcode, or submit a free-form, single-line address and receive a structured, validated record back. Both endpoints work for the Republic of Ireland too.
- [Retrieve by UMPRN](https://docs.ideal-postcodes.co.uk/docs/api/umprn.md): Returns a multiple occupancy address identified via its UMPRN (Multiple Residence Unique ID).
- [Update](https://docs.ideal-postcodes.co.uk/docs/api/update-config.md): Updates configuration object
- [Update Details](https://docs.ideal-postcodes.co.uk/docs/api/update-key-details.md): Update API Key Details
- [Update](https://docs.ideal-postcodes.co.uk/docs/api/update-licensee.md): Update Licensee

### Data

Our address search and verification APIs provide UK and international address data. Datasets are sourced/licensed from authoritative national providers for accuracy and compatibility with local address formats.

- [Global and UK Datasets](https://docs.ideal-postcodes.co.uk/docs/data.md): Our address search and verification APIs provide UK and international address data. Datasets are sourced/licensed from authoritative national providers for accuracy and compatibility with local address formats.
- [UK Address Form](https://docs.ideal-postcodes.co.uk/docs/data/address-form.md): To capture the standard UK address,
- [AddressBase Core](https://docs.ideal-postcodes.co.uk/docs/data/addressbase-core.md): Essential Elements
- [AddressBase Premium](https://docs.ideal-postcodes.co.uk/docs/data/addressbase-premium.md): Address from Ordnance Survey AddressBase Premium dataset.
- [BEV Austrian Address File](https://docs.ideal-postcodes.co.uk/docs/data/bev.md): Essential Elements
- [Canada National Address Register](https://docs.ideal-postcodes.co.uk/docs/data/cannar.md): General Information
- [AddressBase Classification Codes](https://docs.ideal-postcodes.co.uk/docs/data/classification-codes.md): The AddressBase Classification Codes provide additional identifiers not available on Royal Mail PAF.
- [IE Address (ECAD)](https://docs.ideal-postcodes.co.uk/docs/data/ecad.md): ECAF file including additional data for each address.
- [IE Address (ECAF)](https://docs.ideal-postcodes.co.uk/docs/data/ecaf.md): Essential Elements
- [Find an Address by UPRN](https://docs.ideal-postcodes.co.uk/docs/data/find-address-by-uprn.md): Filtering by UPRN. Does not accept comma-separated terms. Only a single term is permitted
- [FODBOSA](https://docs.ideal-postcodes.co.uk/docs/data/fodbosa.md): Core Metadata
- [Geonames](https://docs.ideal-postcodes.co.uk/docs/data/geonames.md): Geoname ID
- [Geocoded National Address File](https://docs.ideal-postcodes.co.uk/docs/data/gnaf.md): Essential Elements
- [HERE Global Address](https://docs.ideal-postcodes.co.uk/docs/data/here.md): HERE provides comprehensive global address data with standardised formats across 240+ countries and territories.
- [Kadaster](https://docs.ideal-postcodes.co.uk/docs/data/kadaster.md): Essential Elements
- [Kartverket](https://docs.ideal-postcodes.co.uk/docs/data/kartverket.md): Essential Elements
- [MoIS](https://docs.ideal-postcodes.co.uk/docs/data/mois.md): Essential Elements
- [Multiple Residence](https://docs.ideal-postcodes.co.uk/docs/data/mr.md): For more information on the Multiple Residence dataset, please refer to our comprehensive guide on this topic: Read More.
- [Northern Ireland Pointer](https://docs.ideal-postcodes.co.uk/docs/data/nip.md): Northern Ireland Pointer data is sourced from OSNI (Ordnance Survey of Northern Ireland).
- [Non-Unique Addresses (NUAs)](https://docs.ideal-postcodes.co.uk/docs/data/nua.md): A guide to understanding and handling Non-Unique Addresses in the Irish Eircode database.
- [Not Yet Built](https://docs.ideal-postcodes.co.uk/docs/data/nyb.md): The Not Yet Built address format is identical to the Postcode Address File format.
- [Standard UK Address](https://docs.ideal-postcodes.co.uk/docs/data/paf.md): Our APIs return all data contained in Royal Mail's Postcode Address File.
- [UK Alias Addresses](https://docs.ideal-postcodes.co.uk/docs/data/paf-aliases.md): The Alias address format is identical to the Postcode Address File format.
- [Supported Territories](https://docs.ideal-postcodes.co.uk/docs/data/paf-supported-territories.md): The PAF dataset covers the UK only. This includes:
- [Postcode Areas](https://docs.ideal-postcodes.co.uk/docs/data/postcode-areas.md): What is a Postcode Area?
- [UK Postcode Lists](https://docs.ideal-postcodes.co.uk/docs/data/postcode-list.md): Listed below are links to CSV downloads of UK Postcodes and partial postcodes in CSV format.
- [Reverse Geocoding](https://docs.ideal-postcodes.co.uk/docs/data/reverse-geocoding.md): You can search for nearest addresses using a geolocation (longitude and latitude).
- [SDFI](https://docs.ideal-postcodes.co.uk/docs/data/sdfi.md): General Information
- [Search by UDPRN](https://docs.ideal-postcodes.co.uk/docs/data/search-by-udprn.md): UDPRNs are an eight-digit unique numeric code (e.g. 25962203) for any premise on the Postcode Address File.
- [Search Republic of Ireland Addresses (Eircode)](https://docs.ideal-postcodes.co.uk/docs/data/search-eircode.md): To search for Irish addresses please contact us to have Eircode enabled on your account.
- [Supported Countries](https://docs.ideal-postcodes.co.uk/docs/data/supported-countries.md): - Afghanistan
- [Thoroughfare Descriptors](https://docs.ideal-postcodes.co.uk/docs/data/thoroughfare.md): Thoroughfare descriptors are common words that suffix a thoroughfare like Road, Close and Court.
- [UPUJP](https://docs.ideal-postcodes.co.uk/docs/data/upujp.md): Core Address Fields
- [United States Postal Service Address](https://docs.ideal-postcodes.co.uk/docs/data/usps.md): Essential Elements
- [Welsh Address](https://docs.ideal-postcodes.co.uk/docs/data/welsh-paf.md): The Welsh Postcode Address File format is identical to the Postcode Address File format except locality information such as post town locality dependent are presented in Welsh.

### Guides

Learn more about address verification, integrating our products and account management.

- [Guides](https://docs.ideal-postcodes.co.uk/docs/guides.md): Learn more about address verification, integrating our products and account management.
- [Allowed URLs](https://docs.ideal-postcodes.co.uk/docs/guides/allowed-urls.md): Each Key can be restricted against a number of URLs. Individual Licensee Keys can also have allowed URLs assigned to them.
- [API Key](https://docs.ideal-postcodes.co.uk/docs/guides/api-key.md): What is an API Key?
- [API Key Security](https://docs.ideal-postcodes.co.uk/docs/guides/api-key-secure.md): In order to mitigate the risk of misuse, usage of your API Key can be controlled in the following ways:
- [API Key Settings](https://docs.ideal-postcodes.co.uk/docs/guides/api-key-settings.md): You can limit your API Key usage via the Security panel on your dashboard. This is important when you want to control how many lookups you spend per day.
- [Automated Top-Ups](https://docs.ideal-postcodes.co.uk/docs/guides/automated-topups.md): Automated top-ups ensure uninterrupted access to our address validation service. Follow our guide and set up automated top-ups today. Contact us for support.
- [How to Use ClickCleanse](https://docs.ideal-postcodes.co.uk/docs/guides/browser-cleanse.md): Learn how to use the Browser Address Cleanse tool to validate and standardise your customer addresses
- [Setting Up UK Charity Licensing](https://docs.ideal-postcodes.co.uk/docs/guides/charity-licensing.md): This guide walks you through setting up a UK Charity PAF licence with Royal Mail via Ideal Postcodes.
- [ChatGPT for Docs](https://docs.ideal-postcodes.co.uk/docs/guides/chatgpt-for-docs.md): We are in the very early stages of using an LLM to improve the developer experience around our tools and APIs. Please use ChatGPT for Docs and rate the answers to your questions so we can improve the agent and our documentation.
- [Email Validation Guide](https://docs.ideal-postcodes.co.uk/docs/guides/email-validation.md): Check if an email address is deliverable using our Email Validation service.
- [Error Codes and Common Fixes](https://docs.ideal-postcodes.co.uk/docs/guides/error-codes.md): Common API error codes with causes and fixes, ordered by how frequently we observe the resolutions.
- [Build with AI](https://docs.ideal-postcodes.co.uk/docs/guides/llms.md): Index of every Ideal Postcodes asset designed for AI agents and AI-powered app builders.
- [Phone Validation Guide](https://docs.ideal-postcodes.co.uk/docs/guides/phone-validation.md): Check if a phone number is valid by using our Phone Validation service.
- [Places API](https://docs.ideal-postcodes.co.uk/docs/guides/places.md): Query for geographical places across countries. Each query will return a list of place suggestions, which consists of a place name, descriptive name and id.
- [Purchasing Lookups](https://docs.ideal-postcodes.co.uk/docs/guides/purchasing-lookups.md): A lookup balance is our form of credit which permits one valid address search.
- [Status API](https://docs.ideal-postcodes.co.uk/docs/guides/status-api.md): Endpoint
- [Sublicensing](https://docs.ideal-postcodes.co.uk/docs/guides/sublicensing.md): Sublicensing Keys allow you to license multiple organisations or individuals under the same key. All managed, controlled and billed to you under the same account.
- [Tagging and Usage Tracking](https://docs.ideal-postcodes.co.uk/docs/guides/tag-and-track.md): Any request which affects your Key balance may be decorated with metadata called tags. This data is stored along with your lookup history and can be queried via the API. We call the ability to label your requests "tagging".
- [Tagging](https://docs.ideal-postcodes.co.uk/docs/guides/tags.md)

### Integrations

Quickly add address validation to eCommerce platforms, CRMs, form builders and more with one of our native extensions or integration guides.

Supports checkout, account forms, and admin panel integration.
- [Bolt](https://docs.ideal-postcodes.co.uk/docs/integrations/bolt.md): Add the Ideal Postcodes Address Finder to a Bolt.new app.
- [Browser Extension Integration](https://docs.ideal-postcodes.co.uk/docs/integrations/browser-extension.md): Integrate Address Validation to Chrome and Firefox Browsers. Available for address validation across different platforms and web-based applications.
- [Build with AI](https://docs.ideal-postcodes.co.uk/docs/integrations/build-with-ai.md): Per-platform guides for adding Ideal Postcodes to AI coding agents and browser-based app builders.
- [Installing Postcode Lookup for Microsoft Dynamics 365 Business Central](https://docs.ideal-postcodes.co.uk/docs/integrations/business-central.md): Integrate Postcode Lookup to Microsoft Dynamics 365 Business Central. Follow our simple guide to enable UK address validation on address fields.

- [Contact Form 7 Address Validation](https://docs.ideal-postcodes.co.uk/docs/integrations/contact-form-7.md): Integrate Address Validation to Your WordPress Contact Form 7 Pages. Postcode Lookup or Address Finder. Quick installation using CF7's form editor. Live support.

### Postcode Lookup

Add Postcode Lookup to your forms with our Postcode Lookup JavaScript package. Simple and quick set up. Guides and live technical support available.

- [Postcode Lookup](https://docs.ideal-postcodes.co.uk/docs/postcode-lookup.md): Add Postcode Lookup to your forms with our Postcode Lookup JavaScript package. Simple and quick set up. Guides and live technical support available.
- [Add Custom Elements](https://docs.ideal-postcodes.co.uk/docs/postcode-lookup/add-custom-elements.md): You may have a specific postcode lookup user interface in mind and don't wish to rely on just specifying a context to generate Postcode Lookup elements and CSS to style those elements.
- [Retrieve Additional Data](https://docs.ideal-postcodes.co.uk/docs/postcode-lookup/additional-data.md): We can also pull in more data from the Postcode Address File by passing more arguments into the outputFields object.
- [Behaviour](https://docs.ideal-postcodes.co.uk/docs/postcode-lookup/behaviours.md): This guide outlines technical details about how Postcode Lookup behaves and interacts with the DOM.
- [Callbacks](https://docs.ideal-postcodes.co.uk/docs/postcode-lookup/callbacks.md): Postcode Lookup also provides callbacks which let you hook into specific events.
- [Configuration Reference](https://docs.ideal-postcodes.co.uk/docs/postcode-lookup/configuration-reference.md): A complete reference for every option accepted by PostcodeLookup.setup. Only context, apiKey and outputFields are required; everything else is optional and has a sensible default.
- [Configure](https://docs.ideal-postcodes.co.uk/docs/postcode-lookup/configure.md): Postcode Lookup exports a setup method to apply address verification to a form. setup requires the following configuration at minimum.
- [CSS Classes](https://docs.ideal-postcodes.co.uk/docs/postcode-lookup/css-classes.md): Postcode Lookup does not inject any styling into your page. Instead it relies on your pre-existing styles for your forms to render the Postcode Lookup UI.
- [Custom Search Button](https://docs.ideal-postcodes.co.uk/docs/postcode-lookup/custom-button.md): You may also specify any clickable DOM element as a trigger to lookup a postcode.
- [Run Custom Callback](https://docs.ideal-postcodes.co.uk/docs/postcode-lookup/custom-callback.md): By passing a function to a callback like onSearchCompleted, you can modify or extend the behaviour of Postcode Lookup.
- [Custom Elements](https://docs.ideal-postcodes.co.uk/docs/postcode-lookup/custom-elements.md): While Postcode Lookup can reduce much of the friction by rendering postcode lookup elements inside the provided context, this is less ideal for forms with complex designs and styling rules. In these instances, you may create one or more custom postcode lookup elements and provide them to Postcode Lookup.
- [Custom Postcode Input](https://docs.ideal-postcodes.co.uk/docs/postcode-lookup/custom-input.md): You may not want the plugin to create its own postcode input field. Instead, you may wish to use an existing field.
- [Enable Full Address Search](https://docs.ideal-postcodes.co.uk/docs/postcode-lookup/full-search.md): You can also enable a full address search, i.e. combine a postcode with house number.
- [Hide Address Fields](https://docs.ideal-postcodes.co.uk/docs/postcode-lookup/hide-fields.md): Instead of writing address attributes to specific input fields, you can also write out the entire address to a general input like a textarea.
- [How it Works](https://docs.ideal-postcodes.co.uk/docs/postcode-lookup/how-it-works.md): Postcode Lookup can be attached to any form with pre-existing address inputs and an empty container to render the Postcode Lookup UI.
- [Messages](https://docs.ideal-postcodes.co.uk/docs/postcode-lookup/messages.md): Postcode Lookup uses a small default set of messages to communicate specific events to the user.  All of Postcode Lookup's default messages can be overridden. They are outlined below:
- [Multi-page Form](https://docs.ideal-postcodes.co.uk/docs/postcode-lookup/multi-page-form.md): You can have the user enter their postcode and open the address form on a new page by saving the user's input in localStorage.
- [Create Multiple Instances](https://docs.ideal-postcodes.co.uk/docs/postcode-lookup/multiple.md): You can create multiple, independent Postcode Lookup fields on the same page. This is useful for certain requirements, e.g. separate billing and shipping addresses.
- [Package Manager (npm)](https://docs.ideal-postcodes.co.uk/docs/postcode-lookup/npm.md): Postcode Lookup is also available without transpilation or minification on npm as @ideal-postcodes/postcode-lookup.
- [Add to React](https://docs.ideal-postcodes.co.uk/docs/postcode-lookup/react.md): 1. Create a context container and attach a reference with createRef
- [Omit Company Name](https://docs.ideal-postcodes.co.uk/docs/postcode-lookup/remove-organisation.md): In many countries including the UK, the organisation name will take precedence as the first line of an address if it is present.
- [Drop-In Script](https://docs.ideal-postcodes.co.uk/docs/postcode-lookup/script.md): Postcode Lookup is shipped in a polyfilled, typed and minified package called postcode-lookup-bundled.
- [Merge Address into One Field](https://docs.ideal-postcodes.co.uk/docs/postcode-lookup/single-field.md): Instead of writing address attributes to specific input fields, you can also write out the entire address to a general input like a textarea.
- [Style Adjustments](https://docs.ideal-postcodes.co.uk/docs/postcode-lookup/style-tweaks.md): It's possible that the default styling may require a small tweak to allow it to better match your design and site aesthetic. Rather than adding CSS assets, consider applying a style attribute as a setup configuration option. The configurations below apply a style attribute directly to a specific element of the Postcode Lookup.

- [OpenAPI Specification (YAML)](https://openapi.ideal-postcodes.co.uk/openapi.yaml): Machine-readable API specification in YAML format
